title: Ackermann function
prompt: The Ackermann function is defined for non-negative integers m and n by: A(0, n) = n + 1; A(m, 0) = A(m - 1, 1) when m > 0; A(m, n) = A(m - 1, A(m, n - 1)) when m > 0 and n > 0. Implement it recursively and print A(0, 0), A(1, 2), A(2, 3), A(3, 3) and A(3, 5), one per line, in that order.
